mechanism: Methylprednisolone may increase norethindrone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing oral contraceptive efficacy, while norethindrone may inhibit corticosteroid clearance and increase methylprednisolone levels.
action: Consider alternative contraception or increased norethindrone dose; monitor for breakthrough bleeding and corticosteroid efficacy; counsel on backup contraceptive methods during concurrent use.
